[New]

📦 **GLS without an account**: Track GLS parcels with just your **postal code and tracking number** — no MyGLS business account needed anymore. Works in **20 countries**, including the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria, France, Italy, Poland, the United States and Canada.

🧾 **More GLS parcel data**: New GLS capabilities and Flow tokens for **next delivery, delivery window, sender, recipient, last event, ParcelShop, weight, dimensions, status history** and a direct tracking link. In the Netherlands GLS also shares weight, dimensions and the delivery window.

⚡ **New GLS Flow cards**: Triggers for **tracking event, out for delivery, ready for pickup, delivered** and **problem or returning**, conditions for **out for delivery, ready for pickup, a parcel has status…, parcel … is delivered** and **parcel … is being tracked**, and actions to **track a parcel, stop tracking a parcel** and **remove delivered parcels** — so a tracking number from an e-mail Flow can be added automatically.

🌍 **DPD in 19 countries**: Choose your country when pairing DPD: the Netherlands, Belgium, **Germany** (DPD Paketnavigator), Luxembourg, France, Switzerland, the **United Kingdom**, **Italy (BRT)**, Portugal, **Poland** (mobile number + one SMS code), Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Argentina.

🚚 **More DPD capabilities and Flow cards**: New capabilities for **next delivery, out for delivery, en route to ParcelShop, ready for pickup, recently delivered** and **sent parcels underway**. New triggers for **tracking event, out for delivery, ready for pickup, problem or returning, sent parcel status changed** and **sent parcel delivered**, plus new conditions. All DPD triggers now also carry **status code, DPD status, window start/end, delivered time, history, tracking link** and **country** as tokens.

🎨 **New PostNL device icon**.

[Fix]

🧠 **Memory limit crashes**: MyParcel no longer runs out of memory with large PostNL accounts. The 800×800 PostNL delivery image was redrawn for **every parcel on every sync** and again **every 30 seconds** by the delivery-window check — including all old delivered parcels.

📬 **“Wordt vandaag bezorgd” counted as delivered**: The PostNL status “Je pakket wordt vandaag bezorgd” was treated as delivered, so the **Package delivered** Flow could fire while the courier was still on the way.

🔁 **No more repeated triggers**: PostNL, GLS and DPD now fire every parcel trigger **once per change** — no “new parcel” storm on the first sync or after an app restart, and no repeats when a carrier briefly drops, re-lists or flips a parcel.

💥 **App crash on start**: Fixed a crash loop caused by non-existent PostNL delivery-window Flow cards.

[Improvement]

🖼️ **Images on demand**: The PostNL delivery image is now only drawn when someone actually opens it, and reused as long as nothing changes. It still looks **pixel for pixel the same**.

📉 **Far less background work**: Tested with a simulated PostNL account with 6 active and 120 old parcels over 35 minutes:

| | v0.3.2 | v0.3.3 |
|---|---|---|
| PNGs drawn | 333 | 2 |
| Track & Trace requests | 7,812 | 59 |
| Mail-scan downloads | 620 | 10 |
| Full PostNL syncs | 62 | 8 |
| Stored snapshot | 694 KB | 46 KB |

🔎 **Smarter Track & Trace**: PostNL Track & Trace is only fetched for active parcels (max. 3 at a time); delivered parcels reuse their earlier result. MyParcel keeps the **15 most recent delivered** PostNL parcels.

📨 **Mail scans once**: Each mail scan is downloaded once and kept in memory, instead of on every sync.

🧩 **Quieter widgets**: Widgets no longer start a full sync every minute per open screen; widget refreshes are limited to **once every 5 minutes** per device.

🔐 **DPD stays signed in**: DPD reuses its login session instead of signing in on every refresh, and parcel details are only fetched again when a status changes.

⏱️ **Smart polling for GLS and DPD**: Every **15 minutes** when a delivery is near, every **45 minutes** otherwise, and quiet at night. A network hiccup shows a warning with the last known data instead of making the device unavailable.

🌟 Enjoy the improved MyParcel v0.3.3 App with more carriers, fewer surprises in your Flows and a much lighter footprint on your Homey.
